scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:excalidraw-app
scripts.build:wasm: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:components && pnpm run compose:suite
scripts.build:excalidraw-app: pnpm --dir ../../apps/excalidraw-mcp run build && mkdir -p dist && cp ../../apps/excalidraw-mcp/dist/mcp-app.html dist/mcp-app.html
scripts.compose:suite: wac compose components/c4-suite.wac --dep local:c4-engine=components/dist/c4-engine.wasm --dep local:excalidraw-policy=components/dist/excalidraw-policy.wasm --dep local:excalidraw-core=core/dist/excalidraw-core.wasm -o components/dist/c4-suite.wasm && pnpm --dir components exec jco wit dist/c4-suite.wasm > components/dist/c4-suite.wit
scripts.components:load: mkdir -p .wassette-components && (wassette component unload c4-pipeline --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && (wassette component unload c4-layout --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && (wassette component unload c4-engine --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && (wassette component unload excalidraw-policy --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && (wassette component unload excalidraw-core --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && (wassette component unload c4-suite --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && (wassette component unload c4-compiler --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && wassette component load file://$PWD/components/dist/c4-suite.wasm --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components && wassette component load file://$PWD/components/dist/c4-compiler.wasm --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components
scripts.test: sh contracts/c4-pipeline/validate.sh && pnpm --dir ../../runtimes/gondolin-browser check && pnpm --dir components test && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:components && pnpm --dir ../../adapters/mermaid-to-excalidraw run build && pnpm --dir ../../adapters/mermaid-to-excalidraw exec vitest --run tests/cssUtils.test.ts tests/examples.test.ts tests/sequence.test.ts tests/state.test.ts tests/utils.test.ts && pnpm --dir ../../adapters/c4-gondolin run build && pnpm --dir ../../adapters/c4-gondolin test
